# torc_py: supporting task-based parallelism in Python ## 1. Introduction ## **torc_py** is a platform-agnostic adaptive load balancing library that orchestrates scheduling of multiple function evaluations on both shared and distributed memory platforms. As an open-source tasking library, **torc_py**, aims at providing a parallel computing framework that: - offers a unified approach for expressing and executing task-based parallelism on both shared and distributed memory platforms - takes advantage of MPI internally in a transparent to the user way but also allows the use of legacy MPI code at the application level - provides lightweight support for parallel nested loops and map functions...
